My love letter ♡

Hello my loveyy,

I lovee you so much, and I'm so grateful for having you in my life. I really am so lucky knowing na I'm yours and you are mine. I want you to know that I'm always by your side and I'll always be an ally, your best friend, a friend, and your husband muhehehe.

I love you and I miss you despite the fact that we're always interacting online huhu. I'm really thankful, my love, for showing up for me, helping me with things, and guiding me whenever I need it.

Thank you for every little thing you do, even the things you probably don't think are a big deal. Thank you for listening to me, for being patient with me, for making me smile, and for letting me be myself around you. Thank you for staying, for understanding me, and for giving me a kind of comfort that I didn't even know I needed.

I know we can't always be beside each other physically, but I hope you always remember that distance doesn't make you any less important to me. You're still the person I want to tell my stories to, laugh with, annoy, support, and love every day.

I'm grateful for every conversation, every random moment, every “good morning” and “good night,” and every memory we're slowly making together. I don't need everything to be perfect. I just want us to keep choosing each other, keep growing, and keep loving each other through everything.

Thank you for being you, my loveyy. You are one of the most precious parts of my life, and I hope I can keep giving you the same love and happiness that you give me.

I love you always,
your babi ♡

A little more from me.

Hi my love, I know this ain't enough pa compared sa binibigay mo sa'kin. I'm trying po, my love. I'm sorry if for now, this is one of the only ways I can show you how much you mean to me.

I know there are still so many things I want to give you and do for you. I wish I could spoil you, take you somewhere nice, buy you flowers whenever you want, and make more memories with you in person. It really means a lot to me.

I may not have everything right now, but I have a lot of love for you. And whenever I get the chance, I promise I'll make it up to you little by little. Until then, please keep this tiny website as a reminder that somewhere out here, your babi is always thinking about you. ♡
